AUTHORITY_BASIS: [039]-[041] require expected-version CAS for every Mission Fence mutation.
[042]-[045] serialize MISSION_ROTATION as one global transition with immutable intent.
[134]-[145] make ACTIVE_INTEGRATION the sole integration authority and preserve actual Git ref truth across crash.
[161]-[163] order mission rotation as close gates, increment epochs, drain old authority, install new descriptor, rebind namespaces, reopen.
[236], [243]-[245] forbid competing missions, stale integration, blind target movement, and erasure of ambiguous Git truth.
CANONICAL_INTERPRETATION: In [163], 'drain old authority' includes the complete pre-existing ACTIVE_INTEGRATION lifecycle and its external Git-ref truth. The new mission generation is not installed until that authority is terminally reconciled and cleared.

EXPECTED: ACTIVE_MISSION_ID / ACTIVE_MISSION_GENERATION exactly equal OLD mission in intent
actual Mission Fence STATE_VERSION equals expected
target identity and active integration identity still equal the intent observations
PRESERVE: existing ACTIVE_INTEGRATION durable identity/state remains preserved until reconciled
ENTRY_CAS.EFFECT: All new normal old-generation work loses authority at the barrier, while the old mission generation remains canonical solely to finish deterministic drain/reconciliation before cutover.

NORMAL_AUTHORITY: No new normal membership, mutation lease, task mutation authority, or integration reservation may be admitted.
Old memberships/leases are stale because ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH changed.
PREEXISTING_ACTIVE_INTEGRATION: A pre-entry ACTIVE_INTEGRATION is a drain/recovery object, not new normal integration authority.
RESERVED or REF_UPDATE_PENDING with no issued external Git CAS may be deterministically cancelled and cleared with evidence.

REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS must wait for the issued ref operation to return or otherwise establish a transport-level completion/fencing fact, then reconcile actual target HEAD using [144]-[145]. A single early HEAD read is not sufficient while an external CAS may still be in flight.
If actual HEAD == EXPECTED after the operation is known quiescent, classify NOT_COMMITTED and clear/reconcile.
If actual HEAD == CANDIDATE, continue COMMITTED_PENDING_VERIFICATION and finish verification/recovery under OLD mission authority until terminal.
If actual HEAD is neither, set UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION and keep all gates closed.
REGRESSION / ROLLBACK_PENDING / FORWARD_FIX_PENDING must reach a reconciled terminal target state under the existing incident/recovery chain before cutover.
No unrelated candidate may integrate during drain.

DRAIN_COMPLETE_PROOF_REQUIRED: zero remaining normal OLD-generation mutation/integration authority
actual target HEAD and TREE captured after integration transport is quiescent and all recovery is terminal
target HEAD/TREE are bound into immutable DRAIN_COMPLETE evidence
old-authority manifests and relevant control shards show no unresolved mutation/integration authority
all ambiguity is resolved; UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION forbids cutover

CUTOVER_CAS.LINEARIZATION_POINT: The Mission Fence expected-version CAS that changes ACTIVE_MISSION_GENERATION from G to G+1 after verified drain.
EXPECTED: ACTIVE_MISSION_ID / GENERATION still equal OLD mission
ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH equal entry-barrier generations
actual target HEAD/TREE equal DRAIN_COMPLETE evidence
ATOMIC_WRITES: install/rebind new mission descriptor and generation-scoped canonical namespaces
CUTOVER_CAS.RULE: No G2 authority exists before this CAS; no unresolved G1 integration exists when this CAS executes.

POST_CUTOVER_REBIND: All participants renew/create memberships bound to NEW_MISSION_ID/NEW_MISSION_GENERATION and current epochs.
Tasks, leases, queues and generation-scoped namespaces are revalidated/rebound; stale G1 objects remain historical evidence only.
No gate reopens until the authoritative projection proves only G2-normal authority is eligible.
Final transition CAS reopens permitted gates, clears transition state, and advances STATE_VERSION.
CRASH_RECOVERY: Crash before ENTRY_CAS: no authority change; discard/revalidate intent.
Crash after ENTRY_CAS while old integration exists: old mission remains canonical, gates remain closed, and reconciliation resumes from durable ACTIVE_INTEGRATION plus actual Git ref truth.

Crash after external Git CAS but before control recording: recover via [144]-[145] only after the issued operation is known quiescent; never assume an early EXPECTED HEAD means the CAS cannot still land.
Crash after DRAIN_COMPLETE evidence but before CUTOVER_CAS: revalidate ACTIVE_INTEGRATION null, health, target HEAD/TREE, epochs, transition id, and STATE_VERSION before retry.
Crash after CUTOVER_CAS before rebind: G2 is canonical but gates remain closed; resume rebind. Never reactivate G1 normal authority.
Any irreconcilable external state keeps transition fail-closed as UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION.
REQUIRED_TORTURE_TESTS: MISSION_ROTATION races REF_UPDATE_PENDING before external CAS issue.
MISSION_ROTATION enters while REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS; Git CAS finishes after entry barrier but before drain completes. G2 cutover must wait and bind the resulting target truth.
Git CAS transport pauses; an early HEAD read still shows EXPECTED; CAS later succeeds. Rotation must not cut over from the early read.
REGRESSION, ROLLBACK_PENDING and FORWARD_FIX_PENDING each block G2 cutover until terminal recovery.
UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION permanently blocks cutover until reconciled.
A new integration reservation races ENTRY_CAS; Mission Fence CAS ordering permits only one winner and a closed integration gate prevents later reservation.
Crash immediately before and after CUTOVER_CAS preserves exactly one active mission generation.
ACCEPTANCE_FOR_FINDING_RESOLUTION: Independent reviewer confirms [163] drain ordering is preserved and old mission remains canonical through integration reconciliation.
Independent reviewer confirms no G1 Git side effect can occur after G2 mission-generation cutover.
Independent reviewer confirms early HEAD reads cannot falsely prove an in-flight Git CAS quiescent.
Independent reviewer confirms one Mission Fence CAS is the sole G1-to-G2 generation linearization point.
